question: How do sacrifice-remainder eaters become freed from all sins?
premises: sacrifice-remainder eaters are freed from all sins
those who cook for self-reason obtain sin
sense-enjoyment desired as means differs from gross self-centered enjoyment
inference: eating the remnant of sacrifice frees one from sin, while self-centered cooking and enjoyment bind one to sin
uncertainties: long fused compounds require careful pada-splitting
plain_english: Those who eat the remainder of sacrifice are freed from all sins, while those who cook only for themselves obtain sin.
